text:
rachael: quick thought — can we add an invocation-level flagset so the console can surface why a particular token was charged (prefetch, cache-serve, model-fallback, routing-cost)?
sam: +1. Need an API shape and how this affects telemetry volume.
maria: worried about cardinality. if every invocation carries many labels we blow up metrics & traces. what's the smallest useful set?
kevin: UI-wise we only need a single primary reason + optional breadcrumbs. the console card can show: Primary reason / Secondary reasons (collapsed).
devon: proto: add header `X-RW-Cost-Tags: prefetch=true;cache_hit=false;route=spot;fallback=small-model` and a compact enum payload for infra logs. backend writes a compact id to spans, not full key/value.
rachael: that sounds sensible — write id mapping to the event store so console can decode per-invocation. keeps traces small.
maria: mapping table + TTL ok, but who owns GC? we need retention rules so mappings don't grow. maybe sample full tag payloads for 1% of invocations for debugging.
sam: sampler seems right. we already have an invocation-sample pipeline. add a `cost_tags.v1` proto and wire sampler to keep 1% full payloads, 100% compact ids.
kevin: UX request: in the cost dashboard hover we should show estimated token delta (e.g., +4.2% cost because of model-fallbacks) and a link to sample invocations.
devon: rough API snippet for SDKs: ```js
// attach cost tags
client.generate({ prompt }, { costTags: { reason: 'prefetch', cacheHit: false, fallbackModel: 'redwood-small' } })
```
rachael: ops question — rollout strategy? we don't want to change prod headers for all clients at once.
ops-bot: experiment created: `cost-tags-rollout` targeting 10% of traffic on eng-prod (id: exp-ct-2026-03-21).
sam: start with server-side injection for our gateway (no SDK change required). gateway computes tags from routing cache decisions and sets compact id. SDK change can follow.
maria: ensure console has toggle to hide high-cardinality tags and a sampling legend. also add alert if tag cardinality >X/day.
kevin: agree — let's add a 'cost-tag health' panel in console's cost dashboard. shows unique tag ids, sample rate, and top reasons.
devon: I'll draft the cost_tags.v1 proto + mapping service PR. plan: gateway injects compact id by next week to the 10% bucket, sampler hooked in two weeks.
rachael: perfect. can you put a short doc in #docs when PRs are up? also include retention & GC owner.
sam: tagging owner: @devon. GC owner: @maria. UX: @kevin. I'll schedule a 30m sync if needed.
rachael: thanks all — moving this to a short RFC after prototype. :rocket:
